title: Bill Russell's record shop and their awkward relationship
summary: Steinau found Bill Russell stiff and hard to talk to, though he valued the records on Russell's label.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans

blocks.x: Uh, did you ever go on Bill Russell's record shop? Yeah. I went to Bill Russell's record shop a number of times, although I think he, I think he came to town, well, probably around 52 or 53 when I was in San Francisco.
Well, perhaps he didn't. Yeah, I think he was. And Bill was always...

sort of constrained and stiff in manner and never was willing to talk a lot that I could get out of them. We were always very awkward with each other. Certainly I thought the records he put out under his label were very interesting and very good. I still have a number of them. And what little I've read of his writings I enjoyed but Bill was always difficult for me to talk to so I just didn't talk to him or he didn't talk to me much or something of the sort.
